wiki.title: Bergram Stumpfinger
wiki.text:
Bergram Stumpfinger is an NPC boss that can be found in the Bergram Stumpfinger's Ghost battle, located in Blackspore Swamp. He is a dwarf ghost that is angry at someone for a reason and haunting the battle. The player must venture in and defeat him.
